scope: Offline CutPerception development on the existing 1-mm sided print only. No controller permission, confirmation, reset of signed gates or new specimen.
sensor: All 20 work/loaded/look/park/pulled exposures, without selection. Use the actual 70-degree 1280x960 image, its rigid calibration, raw depth and the original deterministic Gaussian 0.5-mm depth perturbation. Fresh stateless CutPerception per image and depth variant, in camera coordinates; image content only. Phase, requested length, filenames, truth and controller history cannot enter either estimator. Freeze predictions before scoring poses, constraints or case labels. Park is diagnostic only.
method: Each material ordinate is the printed boundary between successive row inks on each bank. Estimate the 3D inner end of each boundary separately from connected same-bank contacts and measured depth. Construct the two prospective coloured central faces using those local endpoints and one pixel-centre barycentric raster convention. A finite connected patch farther than the flanks is positive separation; positive material at the expected depth is positive contact. Never infer a full cut from missing ink, one background pixel, or two banks merely touching in projection. Allow an intact/partial next row next to a fully open row without imposing contradictory conditions on their common edge. Require a unique current transition with support ahead; a resolved earlier bridge or later opening vetoes it. A numeric ordinal is a local development observation, not a connected-prefix certificate. Interpolate on each observed bank independently at the material boundary to get its surface position; the observed cut front is the midpoint, never a backprojection of through-gap depth. Direction and normal come from local bilateral geometry. Report a conservative along-track guard on supported knots only; without adequate support no sweep allowance. The full blade sweep still belongs to the controller.
controls: Known-geometry synthetic perspective-compatible RGB-D: uncut, 3/6/8/9/10 and 11 fully open; either single open triangle of the ninth row (do not call 9); intact earlier bridge, foreground/shutter, nonfinite depth and hidden front, plus oblique projection. Check raw and noisy, local material, front and direction errors and coordinate-frame transforms. Incorrect positive anywhere fails; negative controls may abstain. Require non-vacuous correct positive 3/6/8/9/10 on clean and noisy planar fixtures and a valid uncut initialization on that fixture.
physical_gate: Independently recompute prefix/farthest from all constraints and verify saved faces/labels/poses/hashes. Reference front is midpoint of centre columns 11 and 12 at the structural prefix; tangent is the three-row forward centre chord, normal faces the camera. Numeric outputs must be finite with abs(material error)<0.5 mm, Euclidean front error<0.5 mm and tangent and normal error <=5 deg. Coordinates and rigid tool pose must agree on the SAME exposure. Tool TCP error <=1.5 mm and jaw axis <=5 deg, plus original rigid-fit valid. Require BOTH depth variants at one work or qualified 3-mm closed look per mechanical checkpoint; require 0,3,6,8,9,10. Validate the 9/10 threshold classification and no slit on zero; absence of a slit alone does not localize the uncut entry. Report local numeric candidates separately from action eligibility and score every one, including park. For a numeric cut additionally verify the independently observed 10-mm guard is not beyond the actual nearer bank along the estimated direction, relative to the same estimated front. No synthesized guard. Score separately from optical pose. Zero unexpected numeric result on a shutter/bridge. Wrong positives disqualify even when another view succeeds.
conditional: Use 50 degrees only if the 70-degree development failures isolate to sampling at 10 mm and all earlier gates are clean. An angular crop calculation is not a 50-degree exposure. No blind rerun, close, or live controller flag on an unsuccessful screen. A clean screen requires separate causal prefix/half-cell/bridge and open-jaw post-advance checks, and independent validation before full nominal/noise/occlusion/slip/relax runs. A cached fix alone is not closure authority.
